name: Aha Orbit Testimonials
author: Estevao Acioli

sections.description:
View Demo | Product page | Documentation | Support

Aha Orbit Testimonials lets you build beautiful, animated testimonial sliders where reviewer avatars orbit around a central card.
Features include:

  • Elliptical auto-layout or manual avatar positioning
  • Autoplay with configurable interval and transition speed
  • Navigation arrows and dot pagination
  • Grayscale effect on inactive avatars
  • Drag and swipe support
  • All configuration—including design and layout—is managed directly in the slider edit screen
  • Robust default colour palettes and layout templates
  • Initials fallback when no avatar image is provided
  • Custom WordPress image sizes for avatars and company logos
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aha-orbit-testimonials folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Aha Orbit → Orbit Testimonials to create your first slider.
  4. Use the shortcode [aha_orbit id="POST_ID"] to embed it anywhere.
sections.faq:
Can I use multiple orbit sliders on the same page?

Yes! Each slider is independent with its own configuration, animations, and testimonials.

Does the plugin work with all themes?

Yes, Aha Orbit Testimonials is designed to work with any WordPress theme and is fully responsive.

Can I customize the colors and styling?

Absolutely! The plugin includes built-in color palettes, and you can also add custom CSS to further customize the appearance.

Is there a limit to how many testimonials I can add?

No, you can add as many testimonials as you need. Performance depends on your server, but typically hundreds are no problem.
